title: Unified 6-Level UI Surface System
description: Replace the dual Level (base|canvas|window|panel|overlay|temporary) + GlassTier (panel|ribbon|menu|windowOptions) systems with a single formula-derived 6-level system: base -> window -> pane -> panel -> dialog -> menu. Each level's background darkens (light mode) / lightens (dark mode) and its glass (blur+alpha) increases, derived from base knobs via oklab color-mix, not hand-tuned. No element manually assigns fill/glass -- everything inherits from data-level CSS cascade. Applies across ui/js/react, ui/styling, the OS shell (framework/renderer/react), coda desktop/assistant, cad/renderer, infinite, animate, legacy compose apps, Storybook, and the native wgpu mirror (ui/wgpu/rs, framework/renderer/wgpu/rs). Full design in /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/all-ui-elements-are-fizzy-shore.md.
summary: Replaced the dual Level (base|canvas|window|panel|overlay|temporary) + GlassTier (panel|ribbon|menu|windowOptions) UI systems with one formula-derived 6-level system: base -> window -> pane -> panel -> dialog -> menu. Each level's background/glass is oklab-mix-derived from a shared set of knobs in tokens.json, cascaded via CSS custom properties under [data-level], and consumed through 4 generic utility classes (ui-surface, ui-glass, ui-glass-chrome, ui-veil) instead of per-component hardcoded fill/glass classes. Rolled out via a 14-agent workflow across: the token generator (oklabMix + level/element paint injection + Rust/TS emission), ui.css (the cascade + utilities), ui/js/react/index.tsx (unified Level API, WindowChrome level prop, ~60 call-site migrations, inline vitest re-baseline), the OS shell, coda desktop/assistant, cad/infinite/animate satellites, legacy compose apps, Storybook, and the native wgpu mirror (Level enum + glass()/glass_chrome() replacing the GlassTier match table). After the workflow, I personally verified the results and fixed two real gaps the Cleanup phase had wrongly marked complete: ui/styling/js/index.ts's applyUiThemeToDocument was still writing the 5 deleted per-tier glass CSS vars (rewired to the new 7 level knobs, added a vitest case), and script.ts was emitting a second, differently-named, dead set of level-knob CSS vars into palette.css that ui.css never read (removed). Also cleaned up 3 harmless stale doc-comment references to the old GlassTier/ui-glass-veil names across ui/wgpu, framework/renderer/wgpu, and coda/client/ui/desktop. Two genuinely out-of-scope, pre-existing bugs were discovered (confirmed via git diff to predate this ticket) and spun off as separate follow-up tasks rather than fixed here: a Pane drag-handle test selector querying a nonexistent data-slot, and a Storybook production build broken by three puzzle story files importing fixtures deleted by an unrelated earlier ticket. Full verification results (vitest, typecheck, cargo, grep sweeps, per-lane build status) are logged as .txt files in this ticket folder.
